name: buildkite-agent
description: buildkite-agent — Buildkite CI agent. Run build jobs, upload artifacts, interact with Buildkite pipelines.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/buildkite/agent/releases/latest/download/buildkite-agent-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf buildkite-agent-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv buildkite-agent /usr/local/bin/ && rm buildkite-agent-linux-amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
